observations: Photo 0 shows a PlayStation 5 Slim console standing on a floor/ledge with a white DualSense controller in front.
Photo 0 shows the console side profile; no visible model/serial label, no ports close-up, no power-on screen.
Photo 1 shows the PS5 Slim front with the white DualSense controller; no visible ports, no accessories laid out, no receipt visible.

claims.claim: Clean PS5 slim with a pad
claims.evidence: Photos 0 and 1 show a PS5 Slim and a white DualSense controller.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No photo of seals, warranty stickers, internal inspection, or repair evidence.
No temperature/usage test, no gameplay session, no error logs.
No close-up of ports or demonstration of HDMI/USB/Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth functionality.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt
claims.evidence: Photos show only one controller; no receipt or multiple pads/accessories are visible.

risks.risk: Ports may be faulty (HDMI/USB/charging) even if the console looks clean; photos don’t confirm functionality.
risks.proof: A short video showing: HDMI connected to a TV, controller pairing, and at least 2 USB ports used (e.g., charging + USB storage) with the PS5 booting to the home screen.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / possible port issues.

risks.risk: Overheating or fan issues may exist but won’t show in still photos.
risks.proof: A clip of the console running a game for 15–20 minutes with the fan audible and no shutdown/errors (or a temperature/fan test screen if available).

risks.risk: “Never opened or repaired” can’t be verified remotely; could be refurbished/previously opened.
risks.proof: Clear photos of warranty/void stickers (if any) and a close-up of the console base/serial label; ideally show the underside and any seal areas.

risks.risk: Accessories/receipt may be missing or not original (seller claims original pads + UK receipt).
risks.proof: Photos of all included items laid out (controllers, cables, pads/accessories) plus a clear photo of the UK receipt.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controller-only / no receipt included.

proof_requests: Video proof: PS5 boots to home screen with HDMI + controller pairing, then demonstrate at least two USB ports working.
15–20 minute gameplay/usage clip to check for overheating/shutdown.
Clear close-ups of any warranty/void seals and the console serial/model label (underside/base).
Photos of everything included laid out, and a clear photo of the UK receipt.
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a PS5 Slim and a controller, but key value drivers (ports working, overheating status, original accessories, and UK receipt) are not provable from the images provided.
